description: List activities (tasks/events), optionally filtered by filter/owner/deal/person/org/done/updated_since. Pipedrive REST: GET /api/v2/activities.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

done.description: Filter by completion — true for done, false for not done.

filter_id.description: Filter by a saved filter id.

updated_since.description: Only activities updated after this RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

name: pipedrive_list_activities
title: List activities
